data.name: Nantu
data.short_meaning: Nara-Simha, the man-lion form of Lord Vishnu
data.long_meaning: The name Nantu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Nara' meaning man and 'Simha' meaning lion. This name represents the divine form of Lord Vishnu known as Nara-Simha, who is a man with a lion's head. The name Nantu signifies bravery, power, and strength, and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine union of man and beast, representing the inner strength and courage.
